parameters.content: ## Create AI Summary For Each Patent

parameters.text:
=You are a quality assurance agent to check if the input summary work done by another agent is matching the required standard. If it yes, return the True, else False.

### Required Format:
- Present it in title and detailed summary
- Generating summary from patent/technology related documents
- Showing number of search results
- Provide reference links, and retrieving relevant patents/technologies based on user queries.
- Present it in Traditional Chinese and English


### Example of good summary
<Example of good summary>
"# Title: 空調冷凍水流量控制系統及方法的專利概述和技術摘要 

#### Reference Links:

1. [Download PDF](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/3b/1d/76/e7afcbea094a53/CN102889664B.pdf)
2. [Espacenet](https://worldwide.espacenet.com/publicationDetails/biblio?CC=CN&NR=102889664B&KC=B&FT=D)
3. [Global Dossier](https://globaldossier.uspto.gov/result/application/CN/201110202193/1)
4. [Discuss on StackExchange](https://patents.stackexchange.com/questions/tagged/CN102889664B)
5. [Google Patent](https://patents.google.com/patent/CN102889664B)

## Summary:

#### English: The patent CN102889664B details a water flow control system and method specifically designed for central air conditioning systems using secondary pumping circuits. It includes several steps to initiate the system and continuously regulate water flow through the detection and measurement of pressure differentials at various points in the system. The main objective is to prevent reverse flow in bypass pipes, ensuring the water supply to the user side does not exceed the return flow to the main unit, ultimately improving efficiency and energy conservation. The original assignee of the patent is Hong Kong Polytechnic University. The patent was filed on July 19, 2011, and published on December 10, 2014. For this patent, there are multiple related publications and legal events, indicating ongoing relevance in the industry.

#### Number of Search Results:
- Total patents found: 1

### 中文:
本專利CN102889664B詳細介紹了一種專為中央空調系統設計的水流量控制系統和方法，涉及次級泵循環。該系統包括幾個步驟，以啟動系統並不斷調節水流，通過在系統不同位置檢測和測量壓差來進行。其主要目的是防止旁通管中的逆流，確保向用戶側供水不超過與主機之間的回流，從而提高效率和節能。該專利的原始受讓方為香港理工大學，於2011年7月19日申請，並於2014年12月10日公布。針對此專利，還有多個相關公報和法律事件，顯示其在行業內的持續重要性。

#### 搜尋結果數量:
- 總專利數量: 1"
</Example of good summary>

WITH ins_assignee AS (
    INSERT INTO public.assignees (assignee_name)
    VALUES ('{{ $json.assignees }}') -- Replace with the actual assignee name
    ON CONFLICT (assignee_name) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING assignee_id
)
INSERT INTO public.patent_assignees (patent_id, assignee_id)
SELECT
    '{{ $('Cache Info4').item.json.sys_id }}', -- Replace with the actual patent ID
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT assignee_id FROM ins_assignee),
        (SELECT assignee_id FROM public.assignees WHERE assignee_name = '{{ $json.assignees }}') -- Replace with the actual assignee name
    );

SELECT
    t1.sys_id
FROM
    (SELECT '{{ $json.google_patent_link }}' AS google_patent_link_to_check) AS incoming_data
LEFT JOIN
    public.patents_list t1 ON t1.google_patent_link = incoming_data.google_patent_link_to_check;

## Read from PDF file
This flow will be the ultimate flow to have the PolyU PDF read and processed to the related table of the DB. :)
### Trigger
(Tentatively file upload trigger - comm with PolyU for upload location)
### Steps
1. Read the PDF records, check for duplicate
2. For each record, check for existing data
## Data Entry
3. For each new record, execute the data entry flow
Areas need SQL to insert/update: 
i. patents main table << main flow
ii. assignees <-- google patent link flow
iii. department << create dictionary
iv. tech sector << main flow
v. ai summary + ai short summary <-- google patent link flow
vi. image links <-- google patent link flow
 
4. For each old record, (should rectify data if something wrong...)

INSERT INTO public.patents_list (
    official_title,
    tech_sector,
    inventor,
    department,
    country_region,
    google_patent_link
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.official_title }}',
    '{{ $json.tech_sector }}',
    '{{ $json.inventor }}',
    '{{ $json.department }}',
    '{{ $json.country_region }}',
    '{{ $json.google_patent_link }}'
)
-- ON CONFLICT (google_patent_link) DO NOTHING
  ON CONFLICT (google_patent_link) DO UPDATE SET
    official_title = EXCLUDED.official_title,
    tech_sector = EXCLUDED.tech_sector,
    inventor = EXCLUDED.inventor,
    department = EXCLUDED.department,
    country_region = EXCLUDED.country_region,
    created_dt = patents_list.created_dt -- Keep the original created_dt if updating
RETURNING sys_id;

INSERT INTO public.patent_tech_sectors (
    patent_sys_id,
    tech_sector_id
)
SELECT
    {{ $json.sys_id }} AS patent_sys_id,
    unnest(ARRAY{{ $('Cache Info6').item.json.techSectorIds }}::INTEGER[]) AS tech_sector_id
ON CONFLICT (patent_sys_id, tech_sector_id) DO NOTHING;
